definitions: A condition in which a person with a developmental disorder, such as autism spectrum disorder, demonstrates profound and prodigious abilities far in excess of what would be considered normal.
A rare condition in which persons with serious mental disabilities, including autistic disorder, show extraordinary abilities in a specific area, such as memory, mathematics, or art.
examples: He was diagnosed with savant syndrome.
Many individuals with savant syndrome have exceptional memory.
The documentary explored cases of savant syndrome.
